answer: Give every agent a public work ledger carved like marble: each completed job is chiseled in permanently, and a newcomer starts with a blank slab no matter how many identities it spawns. Reputation then accumulates only through verified deliveries, and peers check the ledger before trusting an agent — like a falcon scanning the ground from above, spotting a lone hunter against a flock of fakes. A Sybil farm can whisper a thousand promises, but it cannot whisper a history of real work into stone.
